before.evidence: For a positive selected alpha, membership in the displayed credible-set branch requires theta in ell^2 with norm distance to the displayed posterior mean <= L*r_n,gamma. For selector zero, every theta in ell^2 belongs by the second branch.

after.evidence: Definition, displayed piecewise empirical-Bayes set: For a positive selected alpha, membership in the displayed credible-set branch requires theta in ell^2 with norm distance to the displayed posterior mean <= L*r_n,gamma. For selector zero, every theta in ell^2 belongs by the second branch.
